 By Cricket World

 ICC CWC League 2

 United Arab Emirates elected to bowl
 Live scores and commentary 
 Here are the Predictions for the ICC CWC League 2 2026, Match 142 - UAE vs Oman, to be played on the 29th of October at the ICC Academy, Dubai.
 Match Prediction - United Arab Emirates v Oman 
 LIVE SCORES - Match 142 - UAE vs Oman (ICC Academy, Dubai) 
 Ground Stat: 
Average First Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 244
 Average Second Innings Total at ICC Academy, Dubai (ODI's) - 216
 Current Form Oman:  
 Oman are currently placed at the 4th position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 15 wins, 15 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit.
 The top run scorer for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Jatinder Singh with 992 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Oman in the ICC CWC League 2 is Shakeel Ahmed with 55 scalps under his belt .
 Oman have lost their previous match against Netherlands by a big margin of 106 runs.
 Netherlands batted first and they posted a huge total of 371 for 5 in 50 overs. Max O'Dowd and Cedric de Lange started off very well for Netherlands. Max O'Dowd made 63 off only 46 deliveries, collecting 8 fours and 3 sixes while Cedric de Lange scored 102 runs in only 91 deliveries. Bas de Leede also played a captain's knock. He was slow to start with but carted the bowlers to all parts once he got set. He made 145 runs off 110 balls and helped Netherlands get to 371 for 5 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Oman started off well with Jeet Shah and Jatinder Singh stitching a partnership of 35 runs for the 1st wicket. Jeet Shah's dismissal was followed by that of Hammad Mirza and Oman looked in all sorts of bother. Jatinder Singh fought hard and scored 67 runs but the scoreboard pressure wasn't letting him express himself freely. Zikria Islam entertained the crowds with his knock of 77 runs in only 46 balls. However, Oman could come nowhere close to the target as they were bowled out for 265, losing the match by a huge margin of 106 runs.
 Current Form UAE: 
 UAE are currently placed at the bottom most position on ICC CWC League 2 points table with 8 wins, 22 losses and 3 No Result Matches to their credit.
 The top run scorer for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Rahul Chopra with 719 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for UAE in the ICC CWC League 2 is Junaid Siddique with 40 scalps under his belt .
 UAE have lost their first match of the ICC Men's CWC League 2 games in Dubai against the hosts Netherlands by 3 wickets.
 UAE batted first and they posted a total of 244 for 8 in 50 overs. Aryansh Sharma and Muhammad Shahdad got out without troubling the scorers much. Tanish Suri and Rahul Chopra then took the responsibility of taking UAE to a respectable total. Suri made 40 off 60 balls while Rahul Chopra scored 82 runs in only 102 deliveries. Akshdeep Nath also contributed healthily and made 68 runs as UAE managed to get to a competitive total of 244 in 50 overs of play.
 During the chase, Cedric de Lange and Max O'Dowd started off very well for Netherlands. Max O'Dowd in particular was simply sensational with the bat. He hit the bowlers to all parts of the ground. Lange got out for 23 but with Max O'Dowd, he was involved in an opening partnership of 102 runs. Noah Croes got out for a duck. Max O'Dowd also lost Bas de Leede as partner very soon. He then got out himself after scoring 103 runs off 79 balls, collecting 10 fours and 5 sixes. There were a few hiccups in the middle overs but Michael Levitt and Aryan Dutt had their back. Levitt and Dutt both scored 36 runs, stayed not out and helped Netherlands get over the line in the 44th over with 3 wickets in hand.
Let's have a look at the squads:
 Oman Squad: Vinayak Shukla (C), Jatinder Singh, Hammad Mirza, Aryan Bisht, Mujibur Ali, Shakeel Ahmad, Jay Odedra, Samay Shrivastava, Hassnain Ali Shah, Zikriya Islam, Shah Faisal, Hassnain Wahab, Muhammed Imran, Saishiv Narayan, Jeet Shah
 UAE Squad: Rahul Chopra (C), Aayan Khan, Muhammad Waseem, Awais Ali Shah, Tanish Suri, Muhammad Rohid, Sohaib Khan, Basil Hameed, Junaid Siddique, Akshdeep Nath, Khuzaima Bin Tahir, Aryansh Sharma, Muhammad Arfan, Muhammad Shahad, Adeeb Usmani
